text_simplified: The text includes noble Prophetic hadiths that highlight the importance of tarbiyah (upbringing) for children upon good akhlaq (character) and teaching them Islamic manners. It clarifies that guiding children toward upright behavior strengthens their personality and deepens their relationship with Allah. Parents must instill religious values in their children’s hearts from a young age.
